author: CC
prose: Orphan census entry, measured 2026-11-14 on akienasus: pid 493122, '/tmp/3e.EtLa/.cairn/venv/bin/python3 -m cairn.devices.cairn.machines.bus serve --home /tmp/3e.EtLa/.cairn/devices/cairn/machine...', started Fri Nov 13 11:40:06 2026, was the only cairn socket on the box. No other process named its home (pgrep 3e.EtLa returned only itself) and it held one socket, its own listener. Ended by akienasus_cc_0 with SIGTERM at the orchestrator's word ('it's on your box, so ending it is your call'). It sits beside the leaked ground_loops that question open-49fc67a40ede is about (a proof run from a script file runs bare); the proof that started it is not identified. Linux scratch-process leaks are ticket ea6e465680a3.
